name: Ape
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 219, Ape Traits. p. 232, Giant Ape cross-reference.
provenance: Checked against the printed v2 player trait block in the PDFCoffee mirror.
sourceDistinctions: The v2 Giant Ape entry directly refers back to the Ape trait block. The portrait and NPC use the ordinary Ape form.
Rock is presented as a ranged weapon attack with the thrown property and no melee profile. For this encounter, treat the species attack as proficient and use Dexterity for its ranged rolls.

name: Awakened Tree
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 220 in v2. Traits under Awakened Tree.
provenance: Checked against the printed v2 player trait block in the PDFCoffee mirror.
sourceDistinctions: The printed traits use Small size and a 1d6 slam. Medium size, added natural armor and a larger damage die appear in the design discussion and were excluded.
V2 p. 7 reserves the monk’s bonus strike for a conventional unarmed blow. Split Willow kicks with a root, using the monk die.

name: Baboon
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Checked against the printed v2 player trait block in the PDFCoffee mirror.
sourceDistinctions: The player trait block gives the bite 1d6 slashing instead of the smaller die in the design discussion. It does not qualify as a finesse weapon.
No Hands does not appear in the baboon’s trait block. Spindle uses an ordinary shortbow under the core rules for Small creatures.

name: Badger
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Checked against the printed v2 player trait block in the PDFCoffee mirror.
sourceDistinctions: The printed block is Small even though the design discussion describes a Tiny creature.
Giant Badger has a separate player block and is outside this profile.

name: Bat
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Checked against the printed v2 player trait block in the PDFCoffee mirror.
sourceDistinctions: The v2 player traits give 30 ft. of walking speed. The design discussion gives 5 ft.
Giant Bat is a separate player profile. Swarm of Bats has separate encounter rules or uses the supplement’s swarm template. Eavespin is an individual Tiny Beast.
